BrochureContent.Content:
No. 3 Bishop’s Grove is an exceptional newly built, A-rated detached residence extending to approximately 222 sq. m., within an exclusive development of just four homes beside Waterford’s highly sought-after Williamstown Road. Superb proportions, an outstanding contemporary kitchen and attractive overland views combine to create a distinctive home in an exceptionally convenient location.

Generous 2.75-metre ground-floor ceilings and exceptionally large windows create a wonderful sense of light and space. Extensive glazing strengthens the connection with the outdoors, particularly within the kitchen and dining area, where a substantial sliding glass door opens directly to the garden.

Forming the heart of the home, the expansive open-plan kitchen, dining and living area has been designed for both everyday life and entertaining. Finished to a particularly high standard, the kitchen features quartz worktops, integrated appliances and generous preparation and storage space. Practicality and style work beautifully together, creating a superb working kitchen as well as a sociable place in which to cook, dine and gather. An adjoining utility room provides further storage.

Equally impressive is the beautifully proportioned separate living room. Enhanced by a large bow window, this comfortable and generous room provides an inviting space for relaxation and gathering.

Four spacious bedrooms occupy the first floor. The principal bedroom features a bow window, walk-in wardrobe and private ensuite, while the second bedroom also has its own ensuite. A family bathroom serves the remaining bedrooms, complemented by a separate WC at ground-floor level. Both ensuites, the family bathroom and WC are fully tiled, with beautiful tiling and high-quality sanitary ware throughout.

An expansive attic offers excellent potential for conversion, subject to the relevant planning permission and building regulations.

Outside, the property has a lawned rear garden, ample off-street parking and attractive overland views.

University Hospital Waterford is approximately five minutes away by car, with a choice of highly regarded primary and secondary schools, shops and everyday amenities within easy reach. The Outer Ring Road provides convenient access to the city and main transport routes, while nearby leisure facilities include Waterford Castle Golf Club, St Anne’s Tennis Club and Woodlands Hotel & Leisure Centre.

Beautiful and highly functional, this newly built home combines generous living spaces, an A energy rating and an exceptional specification in a superb location, offering a fantastic lifestyle within one of Waterford’s most desirable residential areas.

· Exclusive development of just four homes beside the sought-after Williamstown Road

· Superb open-plan kitchen, dining and living space with quartz worktops, integrated appliances and extensive garden-facing glazing

· Four spacious bedrooms, including a principal suite with walk-in wardrobe, plus two ensuites, a family bathroom and WC
